description: Replace this workspace's operating manual with `body` (markdown), and return the updated guide. An empty body resets it to the built-in default. Each save is versioned. Owner/admin only.

body.description:
body is the new operating manual (markdown). An empty body resets to the
 built-in default.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: set_workspace_guide

version.description: version of the saved guide (0 when reset to the default).

title: Replace the workspace guide
